location.basis: Wikipedia coordinates (23.4179 N, 70.8634 E) fall on a scrub-covered mound of roughly 1 ha bounded by a stream on the west and north, north of Kanmer village; the coordinates are those of the mound centre in Esri World Imagery.

sources.citation_or_service: Esri World Imagery tile service, https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}; Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.north_label_text: Web Mercator grid north (true north at every point; north up)

main_system_reason: No Harappan line could be identified in the imagery.
notes: The mound is covered with scrub and crossed by tracks; a small modern shelter stands on its southern part. The excavated fortification walls are not visible in the current image (with contrast enhancement) or in the archived releases of 2021 to 2026, so no line could be measured.

diagnostics.method: see METHOD.md; deviation peaks from magnitude-weighted gradient-direction histograms folded modulo 90 degrees
